_note: Starting thresholds, chosen to be beatable in 2 to 3 weeks of part-time work. Edit before running /gate. Source column says which file the gate counts from.

unprompted_problem_signals.description: Rows in signals.csv with intent_level >= 2 and grade E2 or E1

india_share_of_signals.description: Share of signals.csv rows from Indian communities, listings or creators

buy_intent_keywords.description: Distinct protein phrases in the 'buy' cluster that autocomplete on Amazon.in or Google India

replies_total.description: Coded replies across all posts plus survey responses, friends and family excluded

behaviour_to_interest_ratio.description: (past_behaviour yes or grade E1) divided by stated_interest yes; survey: waitlist joins over likely 4-5

e1_actions.description: Waitlist signups (incl. from the survey), where-to-buy asks, DMs asking for it, or preorders

decision_rule.pass: e1_actions met AND at least 4 of the other 5 met
decision_rule.insufficient: any metric MISSING, or replies_total not met because reach was under 2,000 views
